title: Mornington Wednesday Market (Main Street Market)
summary: Victoria's longest-running street market – operating over 40 years every Wednesday on Main Street Mornington. 120+ stalls of handmade crafts, home-baked treats, home-grown plants and produce. Rain, hail or shine (high-wind policy applies). Vibrant weekly community gathering.
